description: Check a perpetual futures order and its stop-loss against the permissions, limits and price band, sending nothing. Use before every new position. Not for closing (use close_position). Every order: symbol, side, size_base (from size_position) and a stop. Entry styles add: market, nothing; limit, order_type "limit" and price; at a price, trigger_price; ladder, order_type "limit" and ladder_prices. A market entry may carry worst_price, and then valid_seconds up to 120. Returns preview_id (valid 30 s unless longer) and every check. Next: execute_previewed_order(preview_id).

hold_hours.description: Optional: how long you expect to hold, in hours, to see funding and the round trip's cost (and, with venue "best", to choose by them)

ladder_prices.description: Optional ladder entry: 2-5 limit prices, size_base split evenly across them, one stop-loss beyond all of them (stop_distance_pct counts from the farthest price); order_type limit, no price

leverage.description: Leverage, e.g. 5 (the default); size_position's preview_args carries one your limits allow

oco_with.description: Optional, for an entry that waits (trigger_price or a limit order): the request_id (req_…) of another waiting entry of yours, a trigger entry or an unfilled limit order, on any symbol or venue. One cancels the other: once either opens, the rest of the group is withdrawn (e.g. a buy above resistance or a sell below support)

price.description: Limit price, USD per coin (limit orders only)

reason.description: Optional: why, in your words (up to 500 characters). The person sees it on the approval card and in history; other agents never do

side.description: buy = open or add to a long, sell = open or add to a short

size_base.description: Size in the base coin (BTC, not USD); rounded down to the venue step. Get it from size_position

stop_distance_pct.description: Or the stop as a distance from the entry (trigger price, limit price or mark), 0.02 = 2%

stop_loss.description: Required stop-loss, USD per coin: below entry for buys, above for sells. Or give stop_distance_pct

trigger_price.description: Optional: hold the order and open it at market only when the mark reaches this price (a breakout or a pullback), re-checked then; market orders only. Risk is computed from this price

trigger_valid_hours.description: With trigger_price: hours it waits before lapsing, 1-168 (default 24)

valid_seconds.description: How long the preview stays valid: 30 (the default), or up to 120 with worst_price, for a person or a slow model to decide

venue.description: Venue: sandbox, hyperliquid, okx, bybit or binance. Omitted: the agent's only venue, else hyperliquid if connected, else your only connected exchange, else the sandbox; or "best": the cheapest all-in venue (price plus fee) you may use and have the margin for

worst_price.description: Optional, market entries: the worst price it may fill at, USD per coin (above the mark for buys, below for sells). Execution is refused once the mark is past it, and never fills beyond it

name: preview_order

current.description: The order's value for this rule

deprecation.description: Present only while this tool is deprecated: replacement, removal_date, changelog

layer.description: mandate (this agent's trading permissions), user (the person's global limits), platform or venue

limit.description: The limit it was checked against

rule.description: Which rule, e.g. max_risk_pct, price_band, size_step

checks.description: Every check that ran, all pass

deprecation.description: Present only while this tool is deprecated: replacement, removal_date, changelog

est_fee_usd.description: Trading fee for this order, USD: taker rate for market orders, maker for limit; the exit pays a fee too

est_fill_price.description: Market orders: average fill if executed now against the book, USD per coin; null for limit orders or when the book is too thin to say

est_funding_usd.description: With hold_hours: funding over that time at today's rate, USD; negative = received

est_round_trip_cost_usd.description: With hold_hours: entry fee, exit fee at the taker rate and that funding, USD

est_slippage_bps.description: est_fill_price against mark_price in basis points, positive = worse; a market order never fills beyond the price band

fee_rate_bps.description: The rate used, basis points of notional

fee_source.description: account (your own rate), published (the base rate) or none (sandbox)

legs.description: A ladder entry: [{price, size_base}] per limit leg, USD per coin and in the base coin (e.g. BTC), not USD

mark_price.description: Mark at preview time, USD per coin

requires_approval.description: True: execute_previewed_order will wait for a person's approval

risk_usd.description: Loss if the stop fills, USD

size_base.description: Size after rounding down to the venue step, in the base coin (e.g. BTC), not USD (the same name as the input)

trigger_price.description: A trigger entry: opens at market only when the mark reaches this, USD per coin

trigger_valid_hours.description: A trigger entry: hours it waits before lapsing

venue_choice.description: With venue "best": why this venue (all-in price and the alternatives)

worst_price.description: With worst_price: the bound, USD per coin; it never fills beyond it
